device.description: 8-bit SAR ADC with 1 differential input and 3-wire MICROWIRE serial output
device.note: adc08832.pdf (SNAS015C) p.2 connection diagram (Figure 1) and operating ratings, p.3-4 electrical and timing characteristics, p.9-10 timing diagrams (Figure 20), p.12-13 multiplexer addressing and digital interface

pages: p.2 (Figure 1 pinout, operating ratings VCC 4.5-6.0 V, fCLK 10 kHz-2 MHz), p.3 (logic levels), p.4 (tSET-UP, tpd 250 ns, TRI-STATE delay 180 ns, conversion 8 clocks), p.10 (Figure 20: DO TRI-STATE until tCA after the first CLK, a leading 0, D7..D0 MSB first on CLK falling, then low until CS rises), p.12-13 (digital interface)
notModeled: analog input (the result is always the 0 V code 0x00); input range set by VREF
conversion is clocked by CLK (8 clocks); not timed, the result is ready at once
DO is TRI-STATE until half a clock after the first CLK rising edge (modeled as one released bit), then the leading 0
clock frequency limits (10 kHz-2 MHz) and duty cycle; low-power mode while CS is high
variants: ADC08832 (same datasheet): 2-channel MUX addressed by a start bit on DI, VREF tied to VCC, LSB-first data after the MSB-first data
